# LegatorOCR 0.2.0-pre.52

Fixes from tester feedback.

- **OCR no longer skips lines (new pass, not yet confirmed on the tester's own pages).** After recognition, the page is checked for dark ink that no recognised word covers; each such stretch of ink is read again as a line of its own and put in reading order. Aimed at table-of-contents lines that were left out. I could not reproduce the original skipping here, so please test on the same pages.
- **Profile box shows the active profile.** After choosing or saving a profile its name stays in the box ("name *" once a setting was changed) instead of "Choose profile".
- **"White paper" checkbox** in the colour settings. Without it every page keeps its own paper tone, so left and right pages can differ (cream vs pink). With it the paper becomes pure white on all pages. It was only available from the command line before.

Known, not done: dark shading at the page margin/cut zone, PDF size target (only lowers JPEG quality, does not reduce resolution), text cut at the gutter on curved pages.
